definitions.explanation: Money left over after covering expenses, budget items, or planned uses — used in household, corporate, and government finance to describe funds beyond what was needed or allocated.

examples.japanese: {余剰金|よじょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{余剰金|よじょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新規|しんき}{事業|じぎょう}→新規事業：17985_shinkijigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}した→回す：01158_mawasu⟧。
examples.english: The company put its surplus funds toward a new business venture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余剰金|よじょうきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{繰|く}り⟦{越|こ}される→越す：02282_kosu⟧。
examples.english: The budget surplus will be carried over to next fiscal year.

notes:
{余剰金|よじょうきん} refers to money remaining after expenses or planned allocations are covered.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {余剰金|よじょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to have a surplus
- {余剰金|よじょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り⟦{越|こ}す→越す：02282_kosu⟧: to carry a surplus over (to the next period)
- {余剰金|よじょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分配|ぶんぱい}する→分配する：21141_bunpaisuru⟧: to distribute a surplus
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{余剰金|よじょうきん}: budget surplus
